title: Best Wedding Catering Companies in Dubai: What to Compare
body_markdown:
Wedding catering in Dubai should bring the menu, venue and service together with care. Compare providers on their ability to plan the meal you want, communicate clearly and coordinate with the people responsible for the rest of your celebration.

## About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

## Start with the venue and guest list

Confirm whether the venue has an in-house caterer or permits external suppliers. Share the expected guest count, children’s meals and dietary requirements, along with kitchen facilities, loading access and the time available for setup.

## Use the tasting to refine the plan

A tasting can help you discuss flavour, portions and presentation before the menu is finalised. Ask what the tasting includes and whether it is charged separately. The final service plan should also address how the dishes will reach the full guest list on the day.

## Compare the full wedding proposal

Review menu, staff, equipment, tableware, drinks, setup and clear-down. Clarify the catering team’s responsibilities alongside the planner, venue and other suppliers. Guest-count deadlines, payment, cancellation and any overtime belong in the written agreement.

## Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

## Explore the myCHEF service

If wedding catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.

[Explore wedding catering](/wedding-catering-dubai) · [Request a proposal](/inquiry)
